lines: Applications for the Collingham Scholarship 2024 are now closed.
Reliable Journalism for a Global Impact
The Collingham Scholarship is a prestigious award aimed at encouraging the development of reliable journalism on an international basis.
We believe in the power of journalism to shape societies, foster dialogue, and promote the values of freedom of the press and freedom of expression.

As an advocate for positive links between the United Kingdom and Commonwealth nations, our scholarship provides full funding to one international student, enabling them to pursue an Arts and Humanities undergraduate degree at a UK university.
Open to Commonwealth Citizens Pursuing Higher Education
Are you a Commonwealth citizen with a passion for journalism and a desire to make a difference?
The Collingham Scholarship is open to all Commonwealth citizens currently in full-time study, seeking to pursue a university course in the United Kingdom.

While the scholarship prioritises candidates interested in studying History, Politics, and related subjects, there is no requirement for the successful candidate to pursue a career in journalism or any specific profession.
To be considered for The Collingham Scholarship, please submit your application through our online portal. The application process consists of two key components:
CV Submission: Provide us with your comprehensive CV highlighting your educational background, relevant experiences, and extracurricular activities.

Statement of Purpose: Craft a short statement, not exceeding 200 words, on the subject of “The importance of Freedom of the Press and Freedom of Expression.” Use this to showcase your understanding of these fundamental values and their impact on society.
Ready to take the first step? Click the button below to start your application journey.
Investing in the Future of Journalism
The successful student selected for The Collingham Scholarship will embark on an enriching educational journey, supported by comprehensive funding. Our scholarship offers:
The scholarship covers three years of tuition fees at a recognised UK university, removing financial barriers and enabling you to focus on your studies.

In addition to tuition fees, the successful candidate will receive a further personal bursary. This contribution aims to support your living and study expenses, ensuring you can fully immerse yourself in the educational experience.

As a Collingham Scholar, you will become part of a vibrant community, fostering cooperation and positive links between the UK and your home Commonwealth country. We encourage you to share your knowledge, experiences, and cultural perspectives, strengthening the bonds between nations.
Join us in shaping the future of journalism and creating a positive impact worldwide. Apply for The Collingham Scholarship today!
